gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: Do you want me ___ you at the station?
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want me to meet.

gaps.sentence: There's no point ___ about it now.
gaps.explanation: there's no point + -ing: no point worrying.

gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ about the delay — nothing will change.
I can't wait ___ you the photos.
gaps.explanation: can't wait + to-infinitive: can't wait to show.
